description: Pyronear Risks is an Apache-2.0 machine-learning codebase maintained by Pyronear for wildfire-risk forecasting. Its documentation describes a package and web-service route for preparing environmental inputs and producing predicted fire risk for selected places and dates. Users need weather, vegetation or fire-history features and a trained model configuration; outputs are risk scores or maps, depending on the deployed workflow. Geographic coverage and temporal horizon depend on those supplied data and training settings. The source, installation guidance, examples and documentation are public. A limitation is that a predictive score is not an observed ignition, and performance in a new landscape must be checked against local events. The tool can supply wildfire exposure layers to power-line, road and settlement resilience studies. The catalogue's data-effis is a separate European fire information source for contextual comparison; no model-data pairing was executed. No trained weights, fire dataset or server container was downloaded.
